text.text: Run the studio from one page. Students, their passes and payments are linked, every class or private session is a Class booking, and each teacher sees their own list under Mine. The Passes table shows how many students hold each pass and the churn rate.
The passes you sell, their price and how many students hold each.
Students and drop-ins, with the pass they hold, attendance and payments.
Who is booked into which class or session, with attendance.
Charges, failed cards and refunds, tied to each client.
Class attendance, payments and pass health.
Clear rules on packs save arguments. Put them in writing and keep them short.
A 5-class pack lasts 3 months, a 10-class pack 6 months
Passes are not shared and not refundable, but can be paused for illness
Monthly unlimited renews on the first of the month
A late cancel under 12 hours uses a class
The studio manager can extend a pass once for a documented reason. Note it on the student record.
Teachers are paid per class plus a small bonus for attendance. Keep the schedule steady.
Publish next month schedule by the 20th.
Tally classes taught on the Class bookings board.
Pay on the 5th and send a short summary.
If a teacher cannot teach, they find a substitute from the approved list and tell the manager. Update the booking with the new teacher.
The room should feel calm when the first student walks in.
Lights, heat or cooling and music set.
Mats wiped and aligned, props stocked.
